stories.title: Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs as bank’s bosses hail AI productivity advances
stories.summary: Barclays is cutting 5,000 jobs, about 5% of its 93,000-person global workforce, as part of a wider cost-saving program linked by executives to advances in artificial intelligence. The bank said 1,000 jobs had already been eliminated since the start of the year as it reported higher quarterly profits.

stories.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 review – a thrilling airport novel of a game
stories.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is described as a fast-moving action game spanning Manhattan rooftop parkour, Paris car chases and a climactic battle at a North Korean air base. The review says the developers packed the latest Modern Warfare entry with newspaper-inspired plots, terrorist groups, rogue states and highly capable soldiers.
